caption: The drawing features an ornate architectural frame with two elaborately decorated columns on either side and an arch at the top filled with green foliage, yellow ivy, and pink flowers. The columns are light brown with intricate engravings and support stone sculptures of female figures that stand in recessed niches filled with multicolored flowers. The interior space of the frame showcases a wedding certificate, with the heading "This Certifies" written in large, decorative green and red script at the top center, and the remaining certificate text written primarily in blue and black ink. Below the certificate text is an illustration of a wedding scene, showing two central figures (a bride in a white dress with a veil and a groom in a black suit) facing each other and holding hands, flanked by two standing witnesses dressed in dark clothing, all standing on a brown pathway. Additional flower arrangements in pink, yellow, and green line the edges of the wedding scene at ground level. The overall color palette includes shades of brown, gold, green, pink, and white, giving the image an ornamental and celebratory appearance. At the bottom right corner of the drawing, a handwritten signature and the year "1936" are visible.
title: Marriage Certificate
